examples.en: I ordered a burger with a side of crispy French fries.
examples.zh: 我點了一個漢堡附帶一份酥脆薯條。

examples.en: Dip your hot French fries into tangy tomato ketchup.
examples.zh: 把熱呼呼的薯條沾上酸甜濃郁的番茄醬。

examples.en: Freshly fried French fries taste best when seasoned with salt.
examples.zh: 剛炸好的薯條撒上一點鹽巴調味時滋味最棒。

explains.en: These are long pieces of potato cooked in hot oil until soft inside and crisp outside. People often eat them beside a sandwich or burger. They may add salt or a dipping sauce.
A cook cuts potatoes into sticks and fries them in oil. The finished snack is usually served hot. Tomato sauce is a popular dip.
This popular side dish is made from sliced potatoes. The pieces turn golden and crunchy when cooked in oil. Many people sprinkle them with salt.

examples.en: Throw the empty cup into the recycling trash can.
examples.zh: 把空杯子丟進資源回收垃圾桶。

examples.en: The street was very clean because trash cans were placed at every corner.
examples.zh: 這條街道非常乾淨，因為每個街角都設有垃圾桶。

examples.en: Empty the kitchen trash can daily to prevent unpleasant odors.
examples.zh: 每天清理廚房垃圾桶以防止產生難聞的異味。

explains.en: Put unwanted paper or food wrappers inside this container. It helps keep a room or street clean.
You may find one beside a desk or on a street corner. Some are made for things that can be recycled.
After a picnic, place rubbish in this bin. A family may empty the kitchen one each day.
